# actions/cache v6 source

- Repository: `https://github.com/actions/cache`
- Moving major tag: `v6`
- Commit: `55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9`
- License: MIT, retained in `LICENSE`

The runtime bundle contains the published action manifests and `dist/` files.
Source, tests, and CI metadata are intentionally excluded. gitsss maps the
supported v4-v6 references to this immutable, Node.js 24 runtime copy.
